# CI repair, 2026-11-23

PR #42 changes optional model extras, not signal processing. The failed run
selected CPython 3.14 and built locked NumPy 1.26.4 from source. That NumPy
release predates Python 3.14 support. Added .python-version selecting 3.12 so
uv and CI use a supported runtime without changing the dependency bump.

Duplicate check: current main and recent/open PRs inspected; no existing runtime
pin or competing repair. No engine, probe, vendored source or tolerance changes.
Validation: 398 pytest tests passed, 29 optional/model tests skipped; offline
clean/narrowband bench passed. Native plugin compilation not run locally.
Own adversarial pass: checked uv runtime selection, universal-lock reuse,
optional dependency isolation and preservation of numeric assertions.
